crossRefs.note: Besides all this, between us and you there is a great gulf fixed, that those who want to pass from here to you are not…
His lord was angry, and delivered him to the tormentors, until he should pay all that was due to him.
Then he will say also to those on the left hand, ‘Depart from me, you cursed, into the eternal fire which is prepared…
These will go away into eternal punishment, but the righteous into eternal life.”
We are bound to always give thanks to God for you, brothers, even as it is appropriate, because your faith grows…
A poor widow came, and she cast in two small brass coins, which equal a quadrans coin.

parallels.note: Most certainly I tell you, you shall by no means get out of there, until you have paid the last penny.

translations.web: I tell you, you will by no means get out of there, until you have paid the very last penny.”
translations.bsb: I tell you, you will not get out until you have paid the very last penny.”
translations.kjv: I tell thee, thou shalt not depart thence, till thou hast paid the very last mite.
translations.asv: I say unto thee, Thou shalt by no means come out thence, till thou have paid the very last mite.
